item: A second restore meeting a held settings switch is refused, not reported as a failure
summary: hold_writes raised a bare RuntimeError when a second restore reached the switch while one held settings writes; _carry_and_swap did not map it, so the API answered the generic restore failure and recorded error. Now KvHoldTaken (still a RuntimeError) is mapped to RestoreRefused with the words its neighbours use (the legacy endpoint answers 400; the volume restore, a background job, ends in its error state with the same words; both record refused). Nothing is written before the hold, so only the message and record change. Three dis tests fail on the unfixed code; the existing RestoreRefused count pin moved 3 to 4. No backup_v2.py change.
